title: Graded sentinel + safelist monitoring for staged A/B rollouts and shadow mirroring
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Build a 'graded sentinel' monitoring system that combines a safelist (golden prompts) with a flexible scorecard to protect staged A/B and canary rollouts. The goal is to detect regressions earlier and enable per-cohort quarantine/rollback without requiring full traffic cutoff. This ticket implements the evaluation harness, thresholding strategy, and the automated playbook to quarantine affected cohorts or routes while keeping unaffected traffic live.
background_and_motivation: Several recent staged model flips produced subtle regressions that only surfaced in a subset of customers. Current binary gate (pass/fail) models are brittle for A/B experiments and shadow streams. We need a graded approach that 1) emphasizes a safelist of high-value prompts for quick signal, 2) uses a multi-metric scorecard (quality + safety + latency) with weighting, and 3) supports incremental quarantine and automated rollback playbooks per cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Safelist ingestion pipeline: import and version golden prompt sets for org-level and customer-level safelists
Multi-metric scorecard running in shadow and canary modes with configurable weights
Grade buckets (green/yellow/red) computed per-cohort and per-route with documented thresholds
Automated quarantine action that can isolate up to route-level or customer-level traffic and notify on-call via alerts
Rollback playbook trigger that can be exercised in dry-run and live modes with audit events logged
Dashboard with trend lines for safelist coverage, scorecard deltas, and cohort-level decision history
End-to-end E2E smoke test that simulates a regression and validates quarantine + rollback flow
implementation_notes: Leverage existing eval harness (ENG-30211 style) but extend to accept multiple weighted metrics and dynamic thresholds
Store safelists as versioned artifacts in S3 with metadata linking to customer cohorts and release tags
Run safelist checks in both shadow and split traffic; only grade samples from matched cohorts to avoid noise
Use streaming aggregator to compute rolling deltas (1m, 5m, 1h) and apply hysteresis to prevent flapping
Expose API for temporary manual quarantine and for automatic actions from the rule engine
Trade-offs: tighter thresholds reduce false negatives but increase false positives; we'll start conservative (favor availability) and iterate
Privacy note: masked prompt samples only stored when explicit consent exists; otherwise checksum-based fingerprinting used
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Spike complete — proof-of-concept can score a 200-sample safelist against live shadow traffic with <150ms per-sample overhead
2026-03-11: Implemented weighted scorecard prototype and initial dashboard mockups; shared with PM and SRE for feedback
2026-03-12: QA and infra review scheduled; added per-cohort quarantine granularity after design sync
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives quarantine healthy customers. Mitigation: two-step action (soft quarantine with traffic mirroring + alert) before hard cutover, require manual approval for >5% traffic impact
Risk: extra latency for shadow scoring. Mitigation: async scoring pipeline and bounded sample rate with adaptive sampling
Risk: noisy metrics across low-volume customers. Mitigation: minimum-sample gating and fallback to aggregate signals
test_plan: Unit tests for safelist ingestion and version resolution
Integration test that runs safelist scorecard against synthetic regression scenarios
Chaos test: simulate delayed metrics and ensure hysteresis prevents flapping quarantine
Canary exercise: run on internal canary org then staged external cohort (5% -> 20% -> 50%)
Manual runbook validation with on-call team and SRE before any auto-action enabled
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dry-run): enable scoring on shadow traffic for all active rollouts; no automated actions; collect baseline for 7 days
Phase 1 (soft quarantine): enable automated soft quarantine for internal orgs only; notify Slack + PagerDuty
Phase 2 (limited auto actions): enable per-route quarantine for selected customers with opt-in; monitor metrics for 14 days
Phase 3 (general availability): expand automatic rollback playbook with audit log and revert window settings
monitoring_and_alerting: Critical alert when a cohort enters red for >3 consecutive 5-minute windows
Warning when safelist coverage drops below 70% for a release
Audit trail event for every quarantine/rollback action with actor (system/manual), reason, and revert link
Dashboard widgets: scorecard heatmap, safelist pass rate, quarantine actions timeline
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Lee): prefer conservative auto-actions initially; asked for explicit opt-in checkbox for customer-impacting quarantines
SRE (Marina Lopez): suggested adding circuit-breaker for control plane overload during mass quarantines
Design (Cam Nguyen): recommended clearer visual affordances on dashboard for yellow vs red grades
next_steps: Finish infra work to persist score deltas to metrics pipeline (ETA 2026-03-16)
Run internal canary with customer-eng org and collect baseline signals (ETA 2026-03-20)
Schedule on-call dry-run and tabletop exercise with support and SRE (ETA 2026-03-24)
